title: Speed dependent descending control of freezing behavior in Drosophila melanogaster
quote: We found that CsChrimson activation of DNp09 neurons was sufficient to trigger freezing in 61.5% (492/800) of trials
mapping_basis: Paper name DNp09 is a MANC type, but the kit lists SS01540 as AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71, DNp71's hemibrain name is DNp09); paper's own name DNp09 chosen.
stimulation: 627 nm red LEDs, 0.025 mW/mm2, 10 repetitions of 2 s on / 20 s off
sensory_condition: single flies in walking arena, IR backlight
other_cell_types: weak off-target labeling (unspecified; paper refers to FlyLight website)
notes: Freezing scored by pixel motion, not leg tracking. Freezing is preceded by a brief increase in walking speed caused by DNp09 activation; jumps were seen at light offset. Mated females 4-6 d old.

title: Distributed control of motor circuits for backward walking in Drosophila

mapping_basis: MDN is a MANC type name in type_list.csv (synonym DNp50).

sensory_condition: tethered on 6-mm suspended ball, 200 fps video

n_flies_note: N = 7 flies for joint-angle analysis; n = 6 flies per amputation group
notes: Driver line genotype for this figure only in Supplementary Table 2 (not read). Males and females used in tethered activation experiments.
